row.body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says saltlike grains came from the livestock supplement test; my sister coughed all night before warning tape went up.
row.title: cab receipt before sunday's rain

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the saltlike grains while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
